note: Adapted from the soldier description of Holmgren 1913 as quoted by Ahmad 1958 (Indomalayan Termites, Biologia 4); the original is in English. OCR problem: the original sentence 'head almost round without nasus (frontal projection), without hairs or bristles, nasus very long' is self-contradictory (it calls the nasus absent and at the same time very long), and a phrase such as 'without hairs' seems to have been misplaced; it is treated here as 'head almost circular; frontal projection hairless', and the original sentence is kept verbatim in the evidence. Soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head almost circular; the frontal projection (nasus; called 'frontal projection' in the original) without hairs or bristles, the nasus very long, its dorsal outline slightly concave. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 twice as long as segment 2. Base of the mandibles with 2 small teeth. Head length (including the nasus) 2.62, head length (excluding the nasus) 1.71, head width 1.22—1.29; pronotum width 0.61—0.65.
